description: Africa, Australia, the Americas and Eurasia are reconstructed as moving products of plate tectonics whose geological histories still shape their landscapes, resources and life.

s05e01.description: Iain Stewart investigates africa, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s05e02.description: Iain Stewart investigates australia, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s05e03.description: Iain Stewart investigates the americas, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.

s05e04.description: Iain Stewart investigates eurasia, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.
